purpose: Встроить безопасность в архитектуру AI-агента до разработки: санитизация чувствительных данных, контроль входов/выходов, управление секретами, threat-driven controls и проверяемые security gates.

schema.notation: THREATS/ASSETS → SECURITY REQUIREMENTS → INPUT SANITIZER → AGENT/LLM → OUTPUT GUARDRAIL → SECRET MANAGER → SECURITY TESTS → SECURITY GATE → EVIDENCE
schema.description: Источник Lesson 14 задаёт Security by Design, OWASP Top 10 for LLM, adversarial attacks, data poisoning, Guardrails, PII Sanitization и Secret Manager. Colab в папке урока дополнительно демонстрирует PII Sanitizer на Presidio, Output Validator, mock Vault и secure-agent tests.

visual.alt: Lesson 14 Security by Design flow from threats and requirements through input sanitization, agent or LLM, output guardrail, secret manager, security tests, gate and evidence.

curriculum.summary: Урок посвящён Secure by Design для AI-систем, специфичным AI-угрозам, OWASP Top 10 for LLM и архитектурным компонентам защиты: Guardrails, PII Sanitization и Secret Manager. Практика — усиление архитектуры AI-агента компонентами безопасности.
requirements: Применять принципы безопасного проектирования к AI-системам
Выявлять и митигировать специфичные уязвимости AI-моделей
Учитывать adversarial attacks и data poisoning
Усиливать AI-агента sanitizer, validator и secret manager
homework: Практика: усилить архитектуру AI-агента компонентами безопасности — sanitizer, validator, secret manager.

architect_pro.summary: Профессиональный Security by Design начинается с assets/trust boundaries/threats и заканчивается проверяемыми controls. Sanitizer и guardrail — лишь часть защиты; production-профиль дополнительно связывает IAM, secrets, tool permissions, RAG/data controls, software supply chain и security evidence.
methods: Threat modeling: assets, actors, trust boundaries, attack paths
Least privilege for tools and agents
Security tests mapped to threats and controls
anti_patterns: Передавать реальные secrets непосредственно в prompt/context
Разрешать агенту инструменты без explicit permissions
Не связывать threat → control → test → evidence
Считать notebook demo доказательством production security

father_production.summary: В FATHER Security Plane формирует security profile агента, а DevSecOps Delivery Security превращает его в автоматические проверки pipeline. Lesson 14 задаёт WHAT/WHY; Lesson 18 реализует HOW в CI/CD.
runtime_notes: PII sanitization happens before untrusted model boundary where required
Output validation is explicit and testable
Secrets are referenced, not embedded into prompts or source code
Tool access uses least privilege and auditable policy
Security findings can block PRE-DEV and release gates
Lesson 14 controls become machine-enforced checks in Lesson 18

artifacts: 14 Security by Design архитектура для защиты AI-систем.txt
evidence: Notebook installs and uses presidio_analyzer/presidio_anonymizer for PII handling.
Notebook defines GuardrailValidator that blocks selected dangerous output patterns.
Notebook defines a mock AgentVault / secret manager.
SecureAgent composes sanitizer, validator, vault and mock LLM.
Executed notebook output shows the adversarial SQL-like output 'DROP TABLE users' being blocked by the guardrail.
Notebook contains a separate secret-exfiltration attempt scenario.
gaps: Source lesson does not provide explicit homework acceptance criteria.
Source lesson does not state the year of the lesson.
Course submission status is not confirmed.
GuardrailValidator is an educational keyword-based mock, not a production-grade policy engine.
AgentVault stores a mock secret in process memory; it is not a real external secret manager.
OWASP mapping is named in curriculum, but a separate complete source-to-control matrix is not confirmed in the Lesson 14 folder.
Data-poisoning/adversarial-model mitigations are curriculum topics but not fully evidenced as runtime controls in the notebook.
Notebook evidence does not equal production deployment evidence.
